source: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2025 Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Tax Expense; Income Tax FY2025 from the source line Tax Expense.
source_note: Kshs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. Top line is total income (levies, data, interest and other income), not sales revenue. 2024 expense line items foot to 672,575 but the printed total is 673,267 (issuer 692,000 gap); printed total retained. | Operating Profit (EBIT) FY2025 read from NSE-PLC-Audited-Financial-Statements-For-The-Year-Ended-31-December-2025-1.pdf | Operating Profit (EBIT) FY2024 read from NSE-PLC-Audited-Financial-Statements-For-The-Year-Ended-31-December-2025-1.pdf | The row labelled Operating Expenses held [null, 322,114] (the issuer other operating expenses, 2024 only) and the panel alias matched it, so the real Total expenses row never rendered. That row is deleted and the Total expenses row is relabelled so the printed FY2025 total 741,453 and its FY2024 comparative 673,267 both render.
